title: Export the shared brand surface from the main repo's root package

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Add an \`exports\` map to the root package.json pointing into the existing
web/ tree — nothing moves. Add the dependencies the shared source needs (clsx,
tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, the Radix packages in use,
lucide-react, anthus-vultus, React as a peer). Source ships as raw .tsx; the
consuming app lists this package in transpilePackages, so no build step is
added here.

Surface to export: components/ui/* (accordion, avatar, badge, button, card,
input), components/workspace/* and BotAvatarView.tsx, lib/utils.ts (cn()),
lib/ogImage.tsx, a Tailwind preset built from tailwind.config.ts's
colors/fonts/radius/shadow extensions, and the shared :root custom properties
plus .workspace-prototype/.prototype-* rules from globals.css.

Rewrite the @/* alias imports inside the exported files to relative imports —
that alias only exists in web/tsconfig.json and will not resolve from outside
the package.

Confirm and drop web/lib/auth-context.tsx (no importers found) and
@radix-ui/react-separator (no direct import found) rather than exporting them.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed via PR #294 (2e97aa6), merged to develop then promoted to main via #296. Root package.json exports components/ui/*, BotAvatarView, the workspace trio (WorkspacePanel/Roster/Thread/types), lib/utils, lib/ogImage, a Tailwind preset, and web/styles/shared.css. Verified: npm run build/typecheck/test green, 5 marketing behave features (32 scenarios) still passing against the refactored surface.
